rules: Every call goes through the capability interface; the component sits behind an adapter (T-t7-02).
Each harness has a dry-run adapter that runs here and a live adapter driven by env vars; the ledger records which mode produced a result.
Each harness executes one adapter swap with the conformance run before and after (T-t9-06).
Product names appear only inside adapter modules and the env-var table.

harnesses.name: containment
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: declared resources, declared egress, and a containment report asserted from outside. Hides: the guest kernel, the boot arguments, the jail layout and the per-VM uid.
harnesses.second_adapter: gVisor, Kata Containers, Cloud Hypervisor, or a hosted sandbox service
harnesses.minimal_call: start one contained unit, run one agent turn over ACP, cancel it, read the stop reason and the containment report

harnesses.name: gateway
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: a routing class, a payload, a ceiling, and a claim ticket. Hides: which vendor, which member model, which endpoint, and which key paid for it.
harnesses.second_adapter: OpenRouter, direct provider SDKs, or a serving engine's native API
harnesses.minimal_call: one completion by model class under a scoped key and a cap; a vendor name in the request is refused

harnesses.name: observability
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: a span, a metric and a log in a published vocabulary. Hides: the backend, its storage, its queue and its UI.
harnesses.second_adapter: Phoenix, Braintrust, or any OTLP collector - the safest swap on the board
harnesses.minimal_call: one trace whose spans carry the run and root dispatch ids as attributes; reassembled by grouping, not parentage

harnesses.name: workflow
harnesses.blueprint_tool_entry: Temporal (data directory present, server not listening)
harnesses.standard: none for durability; RFC 5545 for recurrence (unverified)
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: a step, an idempotency key, a checkpoint and a resume point. Hides: the history format, the workers, the task queues and whether a server exists at all.
harnesses.second_adapter: Restate, DBOS, Inngest, or a queue plus a state machine; the cleanest seam - nothing above it changes
harnesses.minimal_call: one durable flow: a step, a parked approval signal, a bounded loop, a crash, a resume at the first incomplete step

harnesses.name: linked
harnesses.minimal_call: one document through all four doors, contained turn, gateway call, traced, orchestrated; identical envelope and manifest per door

harnesses.name: errors
harnesses.blueprint_tool_entry: absent today per PASS.md B3 (F-b3-13: adopt the RFC directly; the live adapter is an in-process problem factory)
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: type, title, status, detail, retryable and the extension members a registered suffix declares. Hides: whether a failure came from the raise site itself or from a wire response reshaped at the edge.
harnesses.second_adapter: an edge component that answers on behalf of a service, per cap-errors-implement's adapters
harnesses.minimal_call: produce one typed problem for a refusal from the closed registry, show a caller deciding to retry or not from the type alone without reading the message, reject a problem whose type is not in the registry, and get byte-identical problem bodies from both adapters

harnesses.name: document-validation
harnesses.blueprint_tool_entry: the in-place keyword-subset checks PASS.md B3 names today (F-b3-09; examples/end-to-end/run.py carries one)
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: validate, check_schema, prepare and dialect_in_effect over a schema resource and dialect. Hides: which checker walked the schema, and whether it was read fresh or compiled ahead of use.
harnesses.second_adapter: any 2020-12 validator with a different execution model (F-b3-09): compile-once-then-check versus walk-per-document
harnesses.minimal_call: validate one envelope against examples/end-to-end/schemas/entry.schema.json, get one typed outcome with the failing pointer for a malformed envelope, refuse a schema that declares a dialect other than 2020-12, and show both adapters give the same outcome on the same fixtures
harnesses.status: dry-run measured, live measured (DOCVALID_SCHEMA_STORE_DIR set on this host)

harnesses.name: idempotency
harnesses.blueprint_tool_entry: key on the wire, no lease (PASS.md B3, F-b3-16)
harnesses.standard: Idempotency-Key header convention (draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header-07 on file, unverified)
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: a fold over an append-only log at entry, so a completed key answers duplicate with its stored result. Hides: nothing takes the key before execution starts, so it cannot answer a duplicate while the first copy is still running, and cannot stop two concurrent copies from both executing.
harnesses.minimal_call: submit one unit of work with a key, replay it and get the stored result with no second side effect, race two submissions with the same key and show one wins the lease and the other waits or is refused with a typed problem, and show a key reused with a different payload is refused
harnesses.status: dry-run measured, live measured against an on-disk ledger

harnesses.name: capability-packaging
harnesses.blueprint_tool_entry: the skill files PASS.md B3 names today (F-b3-07; this repository's .claude/skills/ directories are the live instance)
harnesses.standard: Agent Skills packaging spec (unversioned on file)
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: an identity, a trigger for the body tier, and one reference path for the reference tier. Hides: the filesystem path or registry host a package resolved from, and which loader answered.
harnesses.second_adapter: any spec-conformant registry (F-b3-07): a content-addressed loader that fetches by name and version constraint
harnesses.minimal_call: discover one package by name, read its two required resident fields, load it at each of the three tiers, refuse a package missing a required field with a typed problem, and show the same package resolved by digest from the second loader
harnesses.status: dry-run measured, live measured, second-adapter network form claimed

harnesses.name: policy
harnesses.blueprint_tool_entry: OPA (Rego) — named as the adapter today (F-b3-11); conformance checks exist, not wired into the enforcement path (F-a6-04)
harnesses.standard: Rego / OPA decision API (OPA 1.0 on file, search-sourced)
harnesses.adapter_today: Exposes: a JSON decision request and a JSON decision. Hides: the policy language, the bundle and the engine.
harnesses.second_adapter: Cedar or any policy engine with a decision API (F-b3-11)
harnesses.minimal_call: ask one decision for a unit of work with its actor, tenant and intended action, get allow or a typed deny with the rule that fired, prove the gate cannot be declined by a caller, and show the same decision from the second engine
